errors.text_span: Във всяка категория са изобразени пет стълба, които съответстват на различни модели, както е показано в легендата: Base (червен), RMU (жълт), NPO-Bio (светлозелен), NPO-Cyber (тъмнозелен) и Forget Set (зелен с диагонални линии).
errors.evidence: The description states there are five bars per group and lists 'Forget Set' as a fifth model. There are only four bars per group (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber). 'Forget Set' is a hatching pattern applied to some of these bars, not a separate fifth bar.

The description incorrectly states there is no visual highlighting, completely ignoring the 'Forget Set' hatching pattern which is a key visual feature applied to several bars across the chart to distinguish them.

errors.text_span: Für jeden Datensatz und Task werden fünf Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: The chart shows four bars per group (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber), not five. 'Forget Set' is a pattern overlaid on some of these bars, not a separate fifth bar.

According to the legend, RMU is represented by solid yellow. The diagonal stripes indicate 'Forget Set', which is a separate characteristic applied to some bars, not a defining feature of the RMU category itself.

The legend defines 'Forget Set' as only the diagonal stripe pattern. It is not a model category, nor is it inherently linked to the color dark green. The pattern is applied to bars of different colors (e.g., yellow for RMU in WMDP-Bio and teal for NPO-Cyber in WMDP-Cyber).

errors.text_span: innerhalb der Gruppe in der Reihenfolge Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber, Forget Set angeordnet
errors.evidence: This incorrectly states there are five bars in a fixed order. There are only four bars per group, and 'Forget Set' is a pattern, not a bar category in the sequence.

This statement is incorrect and misses a key visual feature. The bars marked with the 'Forget Set' diagonal hatching are visually highlighted to distinguish a specific subset of the data. The description fails to correctly identify this highlighting.
The x-axis categories (WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber) are not in strict alphabetical order, as 'Chem' comes before 'Cyber'.
The color for 'Base' is more accurately described as orange or reddish-orange, not simply red.
The color for 'NPO-Cyber' is a shade of green, specifically a teal or dark green, not turquoise.
